task.question: What FIFA World Cup milestone was reached in the Tunisia vs Japan group stage match?
task.evidence: This fixture was the 1,000th World Cup match, with the previous milestone (900th) having been reached in the 2018 FIFA World Cup final.

answer:
The milestone reached in the Tunisia vs Japan group stage match was that **Japan became the first Asian team to score multiple goals in a single FIFA World Cup match**, surpassing their own previous scoring record set during a 3–1 victory over Denmark in 2010. Japan won the match 4–0.

FINAL: Japan became the first Asian team to score multiple goals in a single FIFA World Cup match
